content.text: The image on p.10 makes this very clear. Looking directly at the California Driver License card, the DL field shows **O7314062** — the first character is clearly a letter **O** (printed in the same red font as the other alphanumeric characters on the license), not a digit zero. The OCR system misread it as `07314062` (digit zero), but the actual printed value on the license card is `O7314062`, which matches both the driver schedule (f005:s1) and the MVR report text layer (f009:p9).
